title: Polskie Nalesniki (Polish Pancakes)
hookLine: Polish-inspired polskie nalesniki (polish pancakes) with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Add flour, eggs, milk, water, and salt in a large bowl then mix with a hand mixer until you have a smooth, lump-free batter. At this point, mix in the butter or the vegetable oil. Alternatively, you can use them to grease the pan before frying each pancake. Incorporate {m53022_1}, {m53022_2}, {m53022_3}, and {m53022_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, then pour in the batter, swirling the pan to help it spread. When the pancake starts pulling away a bit from the sides, and the top is no longer wet, flip it and cook shortly on the other side as well.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53022_5}, {m53022_6}, and {m53022_7} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to a plate. Cook the remaining batter until all used up. Serve warm, with the filling of your choice. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
